data.name: 逐末之地：60s Exploring the Endless Land：60s
data.detailed_description:
A third-person survival game for up to 4 players.

The disaster countdown has reached 60 seconds. Rush into a laboratory on the verge of destruction, grab everything you can carry, then escape into the forest. Build a camp, explore the unknown, and struggle to survive while waiting for help.

But will rescue ever come?

Perhaps the real thing you need to uncover is the truth behind the disaster.

Story Background: The Collapse of Project Immortality

A corporate giant covertly initiated an experiment known as "Project Immortality," publicly touted as research into an immortality serum. You are a key employee dispatched to its top-secret laboratory, buried deep beneath the Deluo Mountains. Isolated from the world, all operations here were conducted in silence.

Until a routine energy activation experiment caused the specimen, codenamed "Primordial Mycelial Core," to undergo an uncontrollable mutation... The disaster begins now.

Phase One: The 60-Second Scramble

The laboratory is about to self-destruct. Its central system has begun releasing sedative gas.

You and your teammates have only 60 seconds to collect food, tools, medicine, and anything else that might help you survive. Once the evacuation window closes, there will be no way back.

Every item you take could prove useful later. But you can never carry everything.

Do you take more food, or construction materials?
Do you search for weapons, or prepare medicine for an injured teammate?

What you take—and what you leave behind—will shape your chances of survival.

Phase Two: Survival in the Misty Forest

After escaping the laboratory, you reach an abandoned forest observation station deep in the Delo Mountains.

There are no reliable supplies here. No dependable communication. You must use whatever you managed to bring with you to maintain the camp and wait for a rescue that may never come.

Work with your teammates to divide responsibilities:

  • Stay at camp and build facilities

  • Venture into the forest to search for food and resources

  • Craft tools and treat injuries

  • Face the dangers hidden throughout the wilderness

Cooperation may help you survive longer, but not everyone will always agree on what to do next.

  • Build & Manage: Use your limited escaped supplies to build your refuge from scratch. Construct rain collectors for life-giving water, set animal traps for food, light campfires to ward off darkness and fear. The completion of each facility is a defiant strike against despair.

  • Explore & Gather: Explore diverse ecological maps from a third-person perspective. Try fishing by the serene lakeshore, scout for vantage points and rare resources on steep cliffs, mine for minerals in dark caverns, and muster the courage to enter the ominous ruins of the old research institute. Every expedition is fraught with danger and potential.

  • Respond to a Dynamic World: The forest itself is a living enigma. With over 500 randomized events, the game weaves your unique story. It might bring a boon—"Luminous mushrooms appear at the campsite after a night rain"; or a warning—"Unidentifiable, strangely elongated footprints are found by the warehouse"; or an internal crisis—"Under the weight of despair, a fierce argument erupts among teammates." Your every choice triggers unpredictable chain reactions.

  • Cooperation, Discord & The Truth: Cooperation is the cornerstone of survival, but it's not the only answer. You must divide tasks—some venture out, others focus on base-building and healing. However, resource scarcity, moral dilemmas, and the gradually surfacing dark truth can sow seeds of distrust within the team. Scattered experiment logs, anomalous traces, and supernatural encounters all point to a more terrifying question: Is the company's promised "rescue" a hope, or another trap?

【Multiple Endings, Authored by You】
The game's conclusion is not singular. Your key decisions, discoveries, and days survived will collectively lead to vastly different final chapters. The company could be your savior or the ultimate villain; this forest could be your final resting place or a home nurturing new hope. The truth awaits your unveiling...

【Every Game is a Unique Survival Epic】
Are you ready to fight for hope amidst the roar of a countdown, build a home within endless mist, and, in the crevices of survival, uncover a dark truth capable of consuming everything?

Game Features

  • Co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • Single-player mode

  • Third-person survival gameplay

  • 60-second timed scavenging phase

  • Camp construction and resource management

  • Multiple maps to explore

  • More than 500 random events

  • Multiple survival endings

  • A story centered around the truth behind the disaster

data.short_description: Disaster strikes, and you only have 60 seconds. Scavenge supplies with up to 3 teammates in a lab about to self-destruct, escape into an unknown forest, and use 500 types of random events to write your survival story—will you wait to be rescued alive, or uncover the truth the company is hiding?
